title: Bringing every project into one tech community
summary: With a small team of volunteers, I started TExeter Thursday, a knowledge-sharing series that brought engineers from every project together. Its first event was a technical quiz covering every tech stack.
what_would_have_happened: Engineers stayed inside their own projects, with little exchange of technical knowledge.
the_call: Make knowledge sharing a regular, fun event that people chose to attend.
what_i_did: Launched the Thursday series with the TExeter team and ran the first quiz, with questions from every tech stack so all teams had an equal chance.
what_changed: A project team sent a testimonial asking for more sessions and noting that leads, architects and managers joined in. The managing director called it very impressive.

quotes.text: This was a great initiative from the TExeter team towards constructive team building across projects which of key concern in the agile environment.
quotes.role: Project team testimonial, Exeter Software India
